# Municipal Facility Reservation System User Manual

## Introduction

The Municipal Facility Reservation System allows you to easily search and reserve municipal facilities such as gyms, meeting rooms, and heated pools.

## 1. User Registration and Login

### New Registration
1. Click the "Register" button in the top navigation bar
2. Enter your username, name, email address, and password
3. Click the "Register" button - you will be automatically logged in

### Login
1. Click the "Login" button in the top navigation bar
2. Enter your username and password
3. Click the "Login" button

### Logout
- Click the "Logout" button in the top navigation bar

## 2. Language Settings

Use the language select box in the top-right corner to switch between Japanese, English, and Chinese.

## 3. Facility Search

1. Click "Facility Search" in the navigation bar
2. Enter keywords (facility name, location) in the search bar
3. Use the type filter to select "Gym", "Meeting Room", or "Heated Pool"
4. You can also set a maximum price
5. Click the "Search" button to view results
6. Click on a facility to view its details

## 4. Making a Reservation

1. On the facility detail page, select a date
2. Click the "Check Availability" button
3. Available time slots will be displayed - click your desired time
4. Enter the number of people and purpose
5. Click the "Reserve" button to confirm
6. You can view your reservation in "My Reservations"

## 5. Making a Payment

1. On the reservation detail page, click the "Pay" button
2. A QR code will be displayed after payment
3. Show this QR code when using the facility

## 6. Downloading a Reservation Slip

1. On the reservation detail page, click the "Download Reservation Slip" link
2. A PDF reservation slip will be downloaded
3. The slip contains reservation details and a QR code

## 7. Cancelling a Reservation

1. On the reservation detail page, click the "Cancel Reservation" button
2. Click "OK" in the confirmation dialog to cancel

## 8. Profile Settings

1. Click "Profile" in the navigation bar
2. You can change your name, email address, and language settings
3. Enter a new password if you want to change it
4. Click the "Save" button to apply changes

## Troubleshooting

### Cannot Login
- Check that your username and password are correct
- If you don't have an account, please register first

### Cannot Make a Reservation
- Past dates cannot be selected
- Already booked time slots cannot be selected
- Number of people cannot exceed the facility's capacity
